LanguageData.VRE_Aggression_ExtremelyAggressive.descr: Carriers of this gene are incredibly aggressive and are offended by almost anything. They will always respond to insults and slights with a social fight, and will not hesitate to use their melee weapons to get their point across. Mental breaks are always violent.
LanguageData.VRE_Aggression_ExtremelyAggressive.label: extremely aggressive
LanguageData.VRE_DreadHair.description: Carriers of this gene grow hair that naturally forms thick dreadlocks.
LanguageData.VRE_DreadHair.label: dread hair
LanguageData.VRE_EarlyMaturity.description: Carriers of this gene reach skill maturity significantly earlier than others. They can do majority of tasks at the age of 4, and can do wardening, doctoring and construction at the age of 7.
LanguageData.VRE_EarlyMaturity.label: early maturity
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeEntropyCapacity.description: Carriers of this gene have a much higher capacity to withstand the chaotic psychic energy accumulated via psychic powers they use.
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeEntropyCapacity.label: extreme entropy capacity
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeMeditation.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of having much more impactful meditation sessions. They will regenerate psyfocus significantly quicker.
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeMeditation.label: extreme meditation
LanguageData.VRE_FacialSpots.description: Carriers of this gene have small pigmentation spots on their face.
LanguageData.VRE_FacialSpots.label: facial spots
LanguageData.VRE_FastMeleeHitter.description: Carriers of this gene attack much quicker in close-quarters combat. Extra-fast muscle fibers make their strikes much faster.
LanguageData.VRE_FastMeleeHitter.label: fast melee hitter
LanguageData.VRE_FastShooter.description: Carriers of this gene have enhanced reflexes, allowing them to fire their ranged weapons significantly faster.
LanguageData.VRE_FastShooter.label: fast shooter
LanguageData.VRE_HighEntropyCapacity.description: Carriers of this gene have a higher capacity to withstand the chaotic psychic energy accumulated via psychic powers they use.
LanguageData.VRE_HighEntropyCapacity.label: high entropy capacity
LanguageData.VRE_InnatePsylink.description: Carriers of this gene have a slightly restructured brain, which provides them with a natural psylink.
LanguageData.VRE_InnatePsylink.label: natural psylink
LanguageData.VRE_LeapjumpLegs.description: Carriers have special archite-powered muscle fibers in their legs which allow them to jump extremely great distances, causing blunt trauma to anyone unfortunate enough to be in the landing zone.
LanguageData.VRE_LeapjumpLegs.label: leapjump legs
LanguageData.VRE_Leatherskin.description: Carriers of this gene are covered in a thick, rigged leather, which provides a higher sharp and blunt defense.
LanguageData.VRE_Leatherskin.label: leatherskin
LanguageData.VRE_LongPregnancy.description: Carriers of this gene take twice as long to develop a child during pregnancy. Pregnancy lasts three hexamesters - 36 days.
LanguageData.VRE_LongPregnancy.label: long pregnancy
LanguageData.VRE_Maniac.description: Carriers of this gene lack any sort of empathy. They do not care about the suffering of others and take no pleasure from socialising with others.
LanguageData.VRE_Maniac.label: maniac
LanguageData.VRE_PsychicAbility_MoreExtreme.descripti: Carriers of this gene have archite-enhanced connection to the psychic. They have greatly enhanced psychic sensitivity and gain significantly more focus from meditation.
LanguageData.VRE_PsychicAbility_MoreExtreme.label: extremely psy-sensitive
LanguageData.VRE_SerratedEars.description: Carriers of this gene have long, serrated ears.
LanguageData.VRE_SerratedEars.label: serrated ears
LanguageData.VRE_ShortPregnancy.description: Carriers of this gene develop a child during pregnancy much faster. Pregnancy lasts 3 bimesters - 12 days.
LanguageData.VRE_ShortPregnancy.label: short pregnancy
LanguageData.VRE_SlowMeditation.description: Carriers of this gene are finding it difficult to focus during meditation sessions. They will regenerate psyfocus significantly slower than usual.
LanguageData.VRE_SlowMeditation.label: slow meditation
LanguageData.VRE_SlowMeleeHitter.description: Carriers of this gene attack significantly slower in close-quarters combat. Weak muscle fibers make their strikes much slower.
LanguageData.VRE_SlowMeleeHitter.label: slow melee hitter
LanguageData.VRE_SlowShooter.description: Carriers of this gene have lowered reflexes and take significantly longer to aim their shots.
LanguageData.VRE_SlowShooter.label: slow shooter
LanguageData.VRE_SwiftMeditation.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of having a faster meditation sessions. They will regenerate psyfocus slightly faster than usual.
LanguageData.VRE_SwiftMeditation.label: swift meditation
LanguageData.VRE_Transcendent.description: Carriers of this gene have a direct link to a distant archotech, and part of their essence exists outside of our dimension. They are capable of using archon equipment, and in the event of death, they will skip back to another dimension only to return unscathed after some time has passed.
LanguageData.VRE_Transcendent.label: transcendent
LanguageData.VRE_WeakEntropyCapacity.description: Carriers of this gene have a much lower capacity to withstand the chaotic psychic energy accumulated via psychic powers they use.
LanguageData.VRE_WeakEntropyCapacity.label: weak entropy capacity
